tasks.source_note: P0 corrective of the existing Smart Module, not a new epic. Incident A: the manga question ('японцы рисуют или форматом страниц') hit the image generator and reported a daily image quota; cause named by the owner at services/direct_capabilities.py `_DRAW_VERB_STRONG` containing the stem 'рису', classified as INTENT_CREATE_IMAGE, after which `_image_capability_gate()` can end the turn before L1. Incident B: 'бот, что происходит в чате' was answered by analysing a participant's video, then asking which of two videos was meant. Owner forbids adding any lexeme, regex or trigger for such phrases: the model (L1) must decide, using the existing history/memory/search tools. Architectural invariant: the current user message is the task; reply target, quote, forward, recent history, transcript and tool results are evidence, never a substitute task. Explicit commands must survive unchanged: фактчек, чекап, 'Бот, нарисуй ...' with the full user prompt, 'Бот, найди ...' with its argument; 'Нарисуй кота' without the bot prefix goes through L1. Remove the semantic authority of `_DRAW_VERB_STRONG`, `_DRAW_VERB_PREFIXED`, `_CREATE_VERB_GENERIC`, `_IMAGE_OBJECT` and related lexical gates (detect_action_intent, _image_capability_gate, _image_pre_gate_block, _l1_capability_consistency, IMAGE_KEYWORD_RE, legacy/fallback planning, generate_image execution) leaving only the explicit command fast-path. No new LLM classifier, no second summary pipeline, no new user settings. P1 is a bounded revision of the named spots (direct answers, nostalgia pre-gate, search/factcheck markers, vision intent patterns, experience lexical filters, style/self-model). Trace both P0s end to end; do not pass DONE on unit tests alone, and verify negative scenarios independently.
